verses: Taa Seen, yeh aayaten hain Quran ki (yani wazeh) aur roshan kitab ki
Hidayat aur khushkhabri eman walon kay liye
Jo namaz qaeem kertay hain aur zakat ada kertay hain aur aakhirat per yaqeen rakhtay hain
Jo log qayamat per eman nahi latay hum ney unhen unn kay kartoot zeenat daar ker dikhaye hain, pus woh bhataktay phirtay hain
Yehi log hain jin kay liye bura azab hai aur aakhirat mein bhi woh sakht nuksan yafta hain
Be-shak aap ko Allah hakeem o aleem ki taraf say Quran sikhaya jaraha hai.

(yaad hoga) jabkay Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney apney ghar walon say kaha kay mein ney aag dekhi hai, mein o haan say ya to koi khabar ley ker ya aag ka koi sulagta hua angara ley ker abhi tumharay pass aa jaon ga takay tum seenk taap ker lo
Jab o haan phonchay to awaz di gaee kay ba-barkat hai woh jo uss aag mein hai aur barkat diya gaya hai woh jiss kay aas pass hai aur pak hai Allah jo tamam jahano ka paalney wala hai
Musa! sunn baat yeh hai kay mein hi Allah hun ghalib ba hikmat

To apni laathi daal dey, Musa ney jab ussay hilta julta dekha uss tarah kay goya woh aik saanp hai to mun moray huye peeth pher ker bhagay aur palat ker bhi na dekha, aey Musa! khof na kha, meray huzoor mein payghumbar dara nahi kertay
Lekin jo log zulm keren phir uss kay ewaz neki keren uss buraee kay peechay to mein bhi bakhshney wala meharban hun
Aur apna hath apney girbaan mein daal, woh safaid chamkeela ho ker niklay ga baghair kissi aib kay, to no nishaniyan ley ker Firaun aur uss ki qom ki taraf jaa, yaqeenan woh badkaron ka giroh hai
Pus jab unn kay pass aankhen khol denay walay humaray moajzzay phonchay to woh kehney lagay yeh to sareeh jadoo hai
Unhon ney inkar kerdiya halankay unn kay dil yaqeen ker chukay thay sirf zulm aur takabbur ki bana per. Pus dekh lijiye kay unn fitna perdaaz logon ka anjam kaisa kuch hua
Aur hum ney yaqeenan Dawood aur Sulaiman ko ilm dey rakha tha. Aur dono ney kaha, tareef uss Allah kay liye hai jiss ney humen apney boht say emandar bandon per fazilat ata farmaee hai
Aur Dawood kay waris Sulaiman huye aur kehney lagay logo! humen parindon ki boli sikhaee gaee hai aur hum sab kuch mein say diye gaye hain. Be-shak yeh bilkul khulla hua fazal elahi hai
Sulaiman kay samney unn kay tamam lashkar jinnat aur insan aur parind mein say jama kiye gaye (her her qasam ki) alag alag darja bandi kerdi gaee
Jab woh chewuntiyon kay maidan mein phonchay to aik chewunti ney kaha aey chewuntiyon! apney apney gharon mein ghuss jao, aisa na ho kay khabri mein Sulaiman aur uss ka lashkar tumhen rond dalay

Uss ki uss baat say hazrat Sulaiman muskura ker hans diye aur dua kerney lagay kay aey perwerdigar! to mujhay tofiq dey kay mein teri unn nematon ka shukar baja laon jo tu ney mujh per inam ki hain aur meray maa baap per aur mein aisay nek aemaal kerta rahon jin say to khush rahey mujhay apni rehmat say nek bandon mein shamil ker ley
Aap ney parindon ki dekh bhaal ki aur farmaney lagay yeh kiya baat hai kay mein hud-hud ko nahi dekhta? Kiya waqaee woh ghair hazir hai?
Yaqeenan mein ussay sakht saza doon ga, ya ussay zibah ker dalon ga, ya meray samney koi sareeh daleel biyan keray
Kuch ziyadah dare na guzri thi kay aa ker uss ney kaha mein aik aisi cheez ki khabar laya hun kay tujhay uss ki khabar hi nahi, mein saba ki aik sachi khabar teray pass laya hun
Mein ney dekha kay unn ki badshahat aik aurat ker rahi hai jissay her qasam ki cheez say kuch na kuch diya gaya hai aur uss ka takht bhi bari azmat wala hai

Mein ney ussay aur uss ki qom ko, Allah Taalaa ko chor ker sooraj ko sajdah kertay huye paya, shetan ney unn kay kaam unhen bhalay kerkay dikhla ker sahih raah say rok diya hai. Pus woh hidayat per nahi aatay
Kay ussi Allah kay liye sajday keren jo aasmano aur zaminon kay posheedah cheezon ko bahir nikalta hai, aur jo kuch tum chupatay ho aur zahir kertay ho woh sab kuch janta hai
Uss kay siwa koi mabood bar-haq nahi o hi azmat walay arsh ka malik hai.
Sulaiman ney kaha, abb hum dekhen gay kay tu ney sach kaha hai ya to jhoota hai
Meray uss khat ko ley ker unhen dey dey phir unn kay pass say hatt aa aur dekh kay woh kiya jawab detay hain
Woh kehney lagi aey sardaro! meri taraf aik ba-wuqa’at khat dala gaya hai
Jo Sulaiman ki taraf say hai aur jo bakhsish kerney walay meharban Allah kay naam say shuroo hai
Yeh kay tum meray samney sirkashi na kero aur musalman bann ker meray pass aajao
Uss ney kaha aey meray sardaro! tum meray uss moamla mein mujhay mashwara do. Mein kissi amar ka qataee faisla jab tak tumhari mojoodgi aur raye na ho nahi kiya kerti
Unn sab ney jawab diya kay hum taqat aur qooat walay sakht larney bhirney walay hain. Aagay aap ko ikhtiyar hai aap khud hi soch lijiye kay humen aap kiya kuch hukum farmati hain
Uss ney kaha kay badshah jab kissi basti mein ghustay hain to ussay ujaar detay hain aur o haan kay ba-izzat logon ko zaleel ker detay hain aur yeh log bhi aisa hi keren gay
Mein unhen aik hadiya bhejney wali hun, phir dekh loon gi kay qasid kiya jawab ley ker lottay hain

Pus jab qasid hazrat Sulaiman kay pass phoncha to aap ney farmaya kiya tum maal say mujhay madad dena chahatay ho? Mujhay to meray rab ney uss say boht behtar dey rakha hai jo uss ney tumhen diya hai pus tum hi apney tohfay say khush raho
Jaa unn ki taraf wapis lot jaa, hum unn (kay muqabla) per woh lashkar layen gay jin kay samney parney ki unn mein taqat nahi aur hum unhen zaleel o pust ker kay o haan say nikal bahir keren gay
Aap ney farmaya aey sardaro! tum mein say koi hai jo unn kay musalman ho ker phonchney say pehlay hi uss ka takht mujhay laaday
Aik qavi hekal jin kehney laga aap apni uss majlis say uthen uss say pehlay hi pehlay mein ussay aap kay pass deta hun, yaqeen maniye kay mein uss per qadir hun aur hun bhi amanat daar

Jiss kay pass kitab ka ilm tha woh bol utha kay aap palak jhapkayen uss say bhi pehlay mein ussay aap kay pass phoncha sakta hun. Jab aap ney ussay apney pass mojood paya to farmaney lagay yehi meray rab ka fazal hai, takay woh mujhay aazmaye kay mein shukar guzari kerta hun ya na-shukri, shukar guzaar apney hi nafa kay liye shukar guzari kerta hai aur jo na-shukri keray to mera perwerdigar (bey perwa aur buzurg) ghani aur karim hai
Hukum diya kay uss kay takht mein kuch pher badal ker do takay maloom ho jaye kay yeh raah paaleti hai ya unn mein say hoti hai jo raah nahi patay
Phir jab woh aagaee to uss say kaha (daryaft kiya) gaya kay aisa hi tera (bhi) takht hai? Uss ney jawab diya kay yeh goya o hi hai, humen uss say pehlay hi ilm diya gaya tha aur hum musalman thay
Ussay unhon ney rok rakha tha jin ki woh Allah kay siwa parastish kerti rahi thi, yaqeenan woh kafir logon mein say thi

Uss say kaha gaya kay mehal mein chali chalo, jissay dekh ker yeh samajh ker kay yeh hoz hai uss ney apni pindliyan khol den, farmaya yeh to sheeshay say mundhi hui emaarat hai, kehney lagi meray perwerdigar! mein ney apney aap per zulm kiya. Abb mein Sulaiman kay sath Allah rab aalameen ki mutee aur farmanbardar banti hun
Yaqeenan hum ney samood ki taraf unn kay bhai saleh ko bheja kay tum sab Allah ki ibadat kero phir bhi woh do fareeq bann ker aapas mein larney jhagarney lagay
Aap ney farmaya aey meri qom kay logo! tum neki say pehlay buraee ki jaldi kiyon macha rahey ho? Tum Allah Taalaa istaghfaar kiyon nahi kertay takay tum per reham kiya jaye
Woh kehney lagay hum to teri aur teray sathiyon ki bad-shagooni ley rahey hain? Aap ney farmaya tumhari bad-shagooni Allah kay haan hai, balkay)yeh tum fitney mein paray huye log ho
Uss shehar mein no sardar thay jo zamin mein fasad phelatay rehtay thay aur islaah nahi kertay thay

Unhon ney aapas mein bari qasmen kha kha ker ehad kiya kay raat hi ko saleh aur uss kay ghar walon per hum chapa maaren gay, aur uss kay warison say saaf keh den gay kay hum uss kay ahl ki halakat kay waqt mojood na thay aur hum bilkul sachay hain
Unhon ney makar (khufiya tadbeer) kiya aur hum ney bhi aur woh ussay samajhtay hi na thay
(abb) dekh ley unn kay makar ka anjam kaisa kuch hua? Kay hum ney unn ko aur unn ki qom ko sab ko ghaarat kerdiya
Yeh hain unn kay makanaat jo unn kay zulm ki wajah say ujray paray hain, jo log ilm rakhtay hain unn kay liye uss mein bari nishani hai
Hum ney unn ko jo eman laye thay aur perhezgar thay baal baal bacha
Aur Loot ka (zikar ker) jabkay uss ney apni qom say kaha kay kiya bawajood dekhney bhalney kay phir bhi tum bad-kaari ker rahey ho?
Yeh kiya baat hai kay tum aurton ko chor ker mardon kay pass shehwat say aatay ho haq yeh hai kay tum bari hi nadani ker rahey ho
Qom ka jawab ba-juz uss kehney kay aur kuch na tha kay aal Loot ko apney shehar say shehar badar ker do, yeh to baray pak baaz bann rahey hain
Pus hum ney ussay aur uss kay ahl ko ba-juz uss ki biwi kay sab ko bacha, uss ka andaza to baqi reh janey walon mein hum laga hi chukay thay
Aur unn per aik (khaas qasam) ki barish barsa, pus unn dhamkaye huye logon per buri barish hui
To keh dey kay tamam tareef Allah hi kay liye hai aur uss kay bargazeedah bandon per salam hai. Kiya Allah Taalaa behtar hai ya woh jinhen yeh log shareek thehra rahey hain

Bhala batao to? Kay aasmano ko aur zamin ko kiss ney peda kiya? Kiss ney aasman say barish barsaee? Phir uss say haray bharay ba-ronaq baghaat uga diye? Unn baghon kay darakhton ko tum her gaz na uga saktay, kiya Allah kay sath aur koi mabood bhi hai? Balkay)yeh yeh log hatt jatay hain (seedhi raah say)

Kiya woh jiss ney zamin ko qarar gaah banaya aur uss kay darmiyan nehren jari ker den aur uss kay liye pahar banaye aur do samandaron kay darmiyan rok bana di kiya Allah kay sath aur koi mabood bhi hai? Balkay)yeh unn mein say aksar kuch jantay hi nahi

Bey kiss ki pukar ko jab kay woh pukaray, kaun qabool kerkay sakhti ko door ker deta hai? Aur tumhen zamin ka khalifa banata hai, kiya Allah Taalaa kay sath aur mabood hai? Tum boht kum naseehat o ibrat hasil kertay ho

Kiya woh jo tumhen khushki aur tari ki tareekiyon mein raah dikhata hai aur jo apni rehmat say pehlay hi khushkhabriyan denay wali hawayen chalata hai, kiya Allah kay sath koi aur mabood bhi hai jinhen yeh shareek kertay hain unn sab say Allah buland o bala-tar hai

Kiya woh jo makhlooq ki awwal dafa pedaeesh kerta hai phir ussay lotaye ga aur jo tumhen aasman aur zamin say roziyan dey raha hai, kiya Allah kay sath koi aur mabood hai keh dijiye kay agar sachay ho to apni daleel lao
Keh dijiye kay aasmano walon mein say zamin walon mein say siwaye Allah kay koi ghaib nahi janta, unhen to yeh bhi nahi maloom kay kab utha kharay kiye jayen gay?
Balkay)yeh aakhirat kay baray mein unn ka ilm khatam chuka hai, balkay)yeh yeh uss ki taraf say shak mein hain. Balkay)yeh yeh uss say andhay hain
Kafiron ney kaha kay kiya jab hum mitti ho jayen gay aur humaray baap dada bhi kiya hum phir nikalay jayen gay
Hum aur humaray baap dadon ko boht pehlay say yeh waday diye jatay rahey. Kuch nahi yeh to sirf aglon kay afsaney hain
Keh dijiye kay zamin mein chal phir ker zara dekho to sahi kay gunehgaron ka kaisa anjam hua?
Aap unn kay baray mein ghum na keren aur unn kay daaon ghaat say tang dil na hun
Kehtay hain kay yeh wada kab hai agar sachay ho to batla do
Jawab dijiye! kay shayad baaz woh cheezen jin ki tum jaldi macha rahey ho tum say boht hi qareeb hogaee hun
Yaqeenan aap ka perwerdigar tamam logon per baray hi fazal wala hai lekin aksar log na-shukri kertay hain
Be-shak aap ka rab unn cheezon ko bhi janta hai jinhen unn kay seenay chupa rahey hain aur jinhen zahir ker rahey hain
Aasman o zamin ki koi posheedah cheez bhi aisi nahi jo roshan aur khulli kitab mein na ho
Yaqeenan yeh Quran bani israeel kay samney unn aksar cheezon ka biyan ker raha hai jin mein yeh ikhtilaf kertay hain
Aur yeh Quran eman walon kay liye yaqeenan hidayat aur rehmat hai
Aap ka rab unn kay darmiyan apney hukum say sab faislay ker dey ga, woh bara hi ghalib aur dana hai
Pus aap yaqeenan Allah hi per bharosa rakhiye, yaqeenan aap sachay aur khulay deen per hain
Be-shak aap na mardon ko suna saktay hain aur na behron ko apni pukar suna saktay hain, jabkay woh peeth pheray roo-gardan jaa rahey hun
Aur na aap andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say hata ker rehnumaee ker saktay hain aap to sirf unhen suna saktay hain jo humari aayaton per eman laye hain phir woh farmanbardar hojatay hain
Jab unn kay upper azab ka wada sabit ho jaye ga, hum zamin say unn kay liye aik janwar nikalen gay jo unn say baaten kerta hoga kay log humari aayaton per yaqeen nahi kertay thay
Aur jiss din hum her ummat mein say unn logon kay giroh ko jo humari aayaton ko jhutlatay thay gher ghaar ker layen gay phir woh sab kay sab alag ker diye jayen gay
Jab sab kay sab phonchen gay to Allah Taalaa farmaye ga kay tum ney meri aayaton ko bawajood tumhen unn ka poora ilm na tha kiyon jhutlaya? Aur yeh bhi batlao kay tum kiya kuch kertay rahey?
Ba-sabab uss kay kay unhon ney zulm kiya tha unn per baat jamm jaye gi aur woh kuch bol na saken gay

Kiya woh dekh nahi rahey hain kay hum ney raat ko uss liye banaya hai kay woh uss mein aaram hasil kerlen aur din ko hum ney dikhlaney wala banaya hai, yaqeenan uss mein unn logon kay liye nishaniyan hain jo eman o yaqeen rakhtay hain
Jiss din soor phonka jaye ga to sab kay sab aasmano walay aur zamin walay ghabra uthen gay magar jissay Allah Taalaa chahaye, aur saray kay saray aajiz o pust ho ker uss kay samney hazir hun gay

Aur aap paharon ko dekh ker apni jagah jamay huye khayal kertay hain lekin woh bhi badal ki tarah urtay phiren gay, yeh hai san’at Allah ki jiss ney her cheez ko mazboot banaya hai, jo kuch tum kertay ho uss say woh ba-khabar hai
Jo log nek amal layen gay unhen uss say behtar badla milay ga aur woh uss din ki ghabrahat say khof hun gay
Aur jo buraee ley ker aayen gay woh ondhay mun aag mein jhonk diye jayen gay. Sirf o hi badla diye jao gay jo tum kertay rahey

Mujhay to bus yehi hukum diya gaya hai kay mein uss shehar kay perwerdigar ki ibadat kerta rahon jiss ney ussay hurmat wala banaya hai, jiss ki milkiyat her cheez hai aur mujhay yeh bhi farmaya gaya hai kay mein farman farmanbardaron mein ho jaon
Aur mein Quran ki tilawat kerta rahon, jo raah raast per aajaye woh apney nafa kay liye raah raast per aaye ga. Aur jo behak jaye to keh dijiye! kay mein to sirf hoshiyaar kerney walon mein say hun
Keh dijiye, kay tamam tareefen Allah hi ko sazawaar hain woh unqareeb apni nishaniyan dikhaye ga jinhen tum (khud) pehchan lo gay. Aur jo kuch tum kertay ho uss say aap ka rab ghafil nahi
